trajectory_summary: This is a short, thin call where the rep runs a partial verify script against a proxy (Lawanda, answering for Neil) and lets an unverified, self-reported credit doubt end the call. The rep never surfaces or names the decision-maker-absence problem, never asks for the bill, interest reason, or utility, and closes with a vague callback instruction instead of an owned next step.
outcome_dispute: v1 outcome should be read as no_appointment / soft DQ rather than a clean disqualification. The credit qualifier was never actually resolved for Neil — it was resolved on Lawanda's guess about someone else's credit. The rep also never worked to get Neil on the phone or schedule a specific time when Neil could confirm the number, which means the call ended on structural ambiguity (talking to a non-title, non-account-holder proxy) rather than a hard, confirmed DQ.
